label: US AI regulation · Federal preemption statute enacted (2027)
prompt:
Will Congress enact, and the President sign, a statute that expressly preempts state laws regulating the development of AI models by 31 December 2027?

Resolving yes rebinds the US model to params/federal-preemption.json.
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES on publication in the Statutes at Large / congress.gov of an enacted law with an express preemption clause covering state AI development or high-risk-AI laws. Executive orders, agency rules and court injunctions do not count.

diagnostics.label: Congress declined twice
diagnostics.note: The OBBBA moratorium was stripped 99-1 (July 2025); a December 2025 NDAA attempt also failed.
